title: Extension README promises shipping and links a checkout-only route
observed: The listing says the standalone CLI is for "creating, running, testing, and shipping apps"; shipping is release 5 and the linked README gives only the checkout route.
impact: A marketplace reader expects a shipping route and an installable CLI that release 1 does not provide.
expected: The listing describes release-1 CLI tasks and links an install route.
recheck: Read the published listing in both marketplaces.
